response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (observatories with zero telescopes are not included in the average share); the average share is the mean of per-observatory shares across observatories with at least one telescope.
Each row in telescopes is one telescope (counted with COUNT(*)), and shares are computed as real numbers without rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: Include observatories from the observatories table that have no telescopes (count 0) when computing the average share and the set of observatories.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
